questions.question: Before visiting Thessalonica, in which city were Paul and his team treated shamefully?
Paul told the Thessalonians that his team used a little flattery to win them over. True or false?
What picture did Paul use to describe how gentle his team was with the Thessalonian believers?

answers.text: A nursing mother caring for her children
A shepherd carrying a lost lamb home
A gardener tending his young plants

questions.question: Why did Paul and his team work night and day while sharing the gospel with the Thessalonians?

answers.text: So they wouldn't be a burden to anyone
To raise money for the church in Jerusalem
To buy a place for the church to meet
